headline.text: L1 S3 pecan lot on hold for *foreign material* — Level 1 screen found none, disposition pending from L3.

summary: One active hold: L1 S3 pecan (10024) isolated after FM flag. L2 FFS plastic fragment identified and removed from line; source confirmed as leftover from prior run. L1 S3 kitchen drain plugged with paper towels and mild caps.

holds.title: Pecan 10024 on hold for FM
holds.summary: One pallet flagged for foreign material and placed on hold; Level 1 screen at 00:24 found no FM, awaiting L3 disposition.
holds.status: On hold pending QA disposition from L3.

food_safety.title: Plastic piece found near FFS product zone
food_safety.summary: Plastic fragment identified by Brandon Lance and Raymond Fleming as remnant from previous run; rest of pieces removed from overhead area and line pouches pulled.
food_safety.status: Resolved — source identified, remaining pieces removed, affected pouches taken off line per Wilson confirmation at 03:03.

food_safety.title: Kitchen drain plugged with paper towels and caps
food_safety.summary: S3 kitchen operator found drain overflowing due to clump of paper towels and mild caps; cleared and coaching requested for proper waste disposal.
food_safety.status: Resolved — drain cleared, teams reminded to use trash cans.

quality.title: Wrong jars and lids staged for S3 job
quality.summary: Line leader noticed jars and lids on S3 did not match spec; correct lids not in building, awaiting trailer.
quality.status: Open — staging error caught before use, waiting on correct lids.

quality.title: FFS blade loose due to wrong bolt
quality.summary: 3rd shift operator Fernando Flores found flow wrapper blade loose at cleaning; two bolts tight but wrong pattern used, corrected to proper bolt.
quality.status: Resolved — proper bolt installed, blade verified tight at 01:12.

sanitation.title: Shipping/receiving foot bath not working
sanitation.summary: Foot bath at shipping and receiving entrance reported non-functional.
sanitation.status: Open as of window close; no follow-up posted.

opportunities.text: Consider adding packaging verification step to S3 pre-run checklist — today's wrong jar/lid staging was caught by line leader but spec mismatch should trigger earlier in staging process, based on event at 07:17.
Review FFS blade torque procedure and tooling — loose blade at cleaning (wrong bolt pattern) suggests maintenance standard may not specify correct hardware, based on Fernando's 22:57 discovery.

Consider visual sweep protocol for overhead areas during changeovers — plastic piece from prior run found today echoes risk of leftover parts entering product zone, based on Brandon Lance event at 20:51.
